description:
We are reacting to the massive fallout within the Democratic National Committee following the release of the highly anticipated 2024 DNC Autopsy Report. Watch as political commentator ImReallyImportant (IRI) goes head-to-head with critics over DNC Chair Ken Martin's leadership, his controversial appearance on Pod Save America with Jon Favreau, and the internal struggle between big donors and party populists. 

Is Ken Martin doing a good job by winning special elections, or is the party facing a major fundraising crisis as we head into the midterms? We break down the details of the flawed autopsy report, the massive war chest gap between the DNC and the RNC, and whether the calls for a leadership change are justified. 

Please subscribe to the original Kick creator to see more.

Chapters:
00:00 - Intro & Meltdown
02:15 - DNC Autopsy Scandal
08:41 - IRI Defends the DNC
14:46 - Fundraising Crisis
22:16 - Ken Martin Speaks
29:26 - Did the DNC Chair Lie
36:16 - Donors vs Populists
45:56 - Calls to Step Down
49:56 - RNC vs DNC War Chest
